messages:
releasebot: Scheduled toggle: enabling feature flag `llm-route-v4` to 5% (cohort: small-canary-7) at 2026-03-21T15:00Z. Plan: 5% -> 20% in 45m -> 50% in 3h with health gates. Pin traffic to model:v2.3.1 for canary. Please ack and call out any blocking telemetry or region concerns.
samir: ack. will watch latency and error-rate panels. added a dashboard link: https://graf.redwood.company/d/llm/route-v4-canary
lee: quick note — we should pin route resolver to commit sha `b7f4c2d` as well. if canary hits 5% and KV-cache miss spike, we should hold.
nana: @releasebot small typo in the release note? It says 50% in 3h but chart shows 2h. confirm timeline.
releasebot: corrected timeline: 5% -> 20% in 45m -> 50% in 2h. thanks @ana.
morgan: EU window starts at 15:30Z, prefer we keep EU traffic at 0% until 16:15Z. can we scope cohort by region?
releasebot: can scope by region. adjusted cohort: small-canary-7 excludes EU.
ops-bot: alert: Prometheus `llm_request_latency_p95` rule currently at 280ms (baseline 220ms). watching for delta during ramp.
samir: if p95 increases >20% from baseline for 5m -> auto-hold and notify #eng-oncall. set threshold in release config?
devops: deploybot will enforce auto-hold at 20% delta for 5m and requires manual ack to proceed. I added the flag rule in the deploy manifest.
lee: rollback playbook snippet for quick revert: ```bash
# revert flag to 0%
curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $RELEASE_TOKEN" \
  https://api.redwood.internal/flags/llm-route-v4/toggle \
  -d '{"percent":0, "reason":"auto-revert-canary"}'
```

nana: also prep model pin revert: `route-service` supports `--pin-model v2.3.0` on the runbook.
morgan: one more ask — add a temporary spike filter for long-tail tokens so we don't hit bursty cost during canary.
releasebot: noted. I've attached the spike filter change to the canary manifest.
ops-bot: synthetic user journey test (session-id test-llm-009) passed at 15:02Z.
samir: ok starting at 15:05Z we flip to 5% for small-canary-7 (non-EU). will monitor logs and kv cache miss. please post any observed errors with bulk sample.
lee: acked. I will watch routing logs + kv cache metrics.
nana: hands off until 15:20Z then available for rollback if needed.
releasebot: deploybot: initiating feature toggle -> 5% now. deploybot: start:6578912370
ops-bot: notice: warning spike in `kv_cache_misses_total` +18% at 15:06Z for canary nodes (replica set 12).
samir: holding at 5%. thanks for the heads up. leaving monitoring on 10s panels.
devops: confirm: canary pinned to model:v2.3.1 and resolver commit b7f4c2d. logs are forwarding to /var/logs/route-canary-7.
lee: I see increased 500s from a subset of nodes (3/12). opening a quick investigative thread.
nana: suggestion: increase canary log level to debug for those nodes for 10m to capture stack traces, then revert.
morgan: still holding EU at 0% per earlier. no objections from EU infra.
releasebot: consensus: hold at 5% for 30m while we triage kv cache misses. if stable (p95 < 1.15x baseline and errors < 1.05x baseline) at 15:35Z we proceed to 20%. Otherwise revert to 0% and run postmortem.
samir: executing holdbook step: notify product, create incident if revert. tagging oncall.
devops: adding the quick revert command to runbook and setting a 10m countdown for manual rollback approval.
lee: temp debug logging enabled on affected nodes. pulling stack traces now.
ops-bot: SLACK: @eng-oncall please note potential revert condition.
releasebot: final: no manual rollback yet. thread will stay open until either we progress to 20% or revert to 0%. thank you all. :folded_hands:
